name: Maudit de l Abysse
description: Éveillé des profondeurs de la croûte planétaire, Maudit de l Abysse émerge des abysses sans fond, manie l'obsidienne brute, déplacement lourd et tellurique, fureur des dieux anciens, ambiance grimdark oppressante. Son pas massive fait trembler le sol, annonçant l'éveil des anciens dieux de la terre.

subject.archetype: Chthonic Titan Warrior, colossal humanoid abomination emerging from collapsing dimensional rift, body composed of fused tectonic plates and volcanic rock, multiple glowing eyes without pupils piercing through darkness, massive jaws of obsidian revealing magma-filled maw, upper body exposed while lower form remains partially submerged in dimensional fissure

loadout.armor_outfit: Natural tectonic carapace armor, irregular obsidian plates fused to flesh-like volcanic rock, basalt scales layered like geological strata, fissures across body glowing with internal magma rivers, jagged crystalline growths erupting from shoulders and forearms, no manufactured elements whatsoever
loadout.arsenal: Two massive drill-like claws foreuse capable of piercing dimensional barriers, each arm ending in rotating volcanic drill-talons surrounded by swirling curse energy, residual shadow tentacles writhing from back as symbiote extensions, persistent curse auras emanating from body corrupting surrounding space

attitude.behavior: Frontline combatant lunging forward with both drill-claws raised overhead in devastating overhead strike position, massive body coiled and leaning into attack momentum, one leg planted in fractured dimensional ground while other pushes forward, upper torso twisting to generate maximum rotational force for strike
attitude.emotion: Primordial rage emanating from glowing eye clusters, mouth opened wide revealing chamber of molten curse-tainted magma, physical expression of unstoppable geological force about to be unleashed, absolute predatory focus on target

palette_names.name: Molten Red-Orange
palette_names.role: Magma cores, glowing fissures, eye glow

palette_names.name: Curse Purple-Black
palette_names.role: Shadow tentacles, curse auras, dimensional corruption

color_and_light.mood: Overwhelming_dread_and_apocalyptic_terror, sense of reality collapsing around observer, primordial menace beyond human comprehension
